notes:
• New icons throughout, and sidebar buttons that stay put when you hide a sidebar
• Text size in Settings → Appearance: Smaller, Small, Medium or Large
• Colour palettes on boards: every colour from an image on one card, add or remove swatches
• Duplicate scripts and cards from the right-click menu; scene colours as a row of dots
• Board cards follow the mouse and connect reliably after the first drag
• New projects start with an outline and a World building board; outlines sit on paper
• Analytics is now Progress; your reminders live in Settings → Goals
• Safer: scripts from other people can’t run code, saves can’t be cut off half-way, and if a file changes in another app while you edit, both versions are kept
• Fonts are built in, so pages break the same offline
